rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who shows contempt or looks down on others.

example.english: They are always scornful of others, so their colleagues do not want to work with them.
example.traditional: 佢成日睇唔起人，搞到同事都唔想同佢合作。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 gaau2 dou3 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use this mainly for a scornful expression, tone, or attitude, especially in more careful or formal language.

example.english: They criticised their opponent in a scornful tone.
example.traditional: 佢用輕蔑嘅語氣批評對手。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 hing1 mit6 ge3 jyu5 hei3 pai1 ping4 deoi3 sau2
